text: The Chongqing Municipal State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission holds 100% of Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group Co., Ltd. and is its controlling shareholder and actual controller.
short: Chongqing SASAC holds 100% of Yufu Holdings and is its actual controller.

source.name: 西南证券股份有限公司收购报告书 (Southwest Securities Co., Ltd. acquisition report), Shanghai Stock Exchange filing (mirror: Sina Finance)
source.quote: 重庆市国资委持有渝富控股 100%股权，为渝富控股 控股股东、实际控制人
source.note: Translation: 'The Chongqing Municipal SASAC holds 100% of Yufu Holdings and is Yufu Holdings' controlling shareholder and actual controller.' The same report adds that the commission is a special institution directly under the Chongqing Municipal People's Government performing its investor duties, and that Yufu Holdings' controlling shareholder and actual controller had not changed in the previous two years.

additionalSources.name: 重庆市国有资产监督管理委员会 (Chongqing Municipal SASAC portal, from 经济参考报): 奋楫逐浪 勇担使命 渝富控股二十年 深化改革谱新篇
additionalSources.quote: 作为曾经的全国首家地方国有独资综合性资产经营管理公司，重庆渝富控股集团有限公司（简称“渝富控股”）
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'As the country's first locally wholly state-owned comprehensive asset-management company, Chongqing Yufu Holdings Group Co., Ltd. (Yufu Holdings)...' Published in the SOE-news column of the Chongqing Municipal SASAC's own portal, which lists Yufu Holdings among the city's key municipal SOEs.
